The plan's two-file model (shared `memory/shared.md` plus per-bot `memory/<bot-id>.md`) is the same shape with one level of inheritance and no way to revoke or erase one kind without rewriting the file. Two further guards have no plan counterpart: provenance is a first-class policy where unknown namespaces are untrusted and a connector prefix overrides locally authored text, and the module says plainly that it "does not infer that a marker makes content safe". A bot-proposed fact recalled from a channel is exactly the text that needs that rule. The plan's routine block has the four parts, the `until_check`, the fifteen-minute floor and the fatigue switch, and no requirement anywhere states how a firing is put to the model, which is exactly the failure this repo already paid for.
